name: gq-income-tax
description: Personal income tax in Equatorial Guinea for tax year 2026 under Ley 1/2024 General Tributaria. Covers the salary tax scale, the business profits tax (IBN) for self-employed people, the minor activities regime (REAM), capital income taxes, the annual global income return (DGRA), residence, deductions, deadlines and penalties. Use for questions such as how much income tax do I pay in Equatorial Guinea, IRPF Guinea Ecuatorial, Impuesto sobre Sueldos y Salarios, self-employed tax in Malabo or Bata, am I tax resident in Equatorial Guinea, and DGRA deadline. Applies to employees, sole traders, professionals, landlords and investors. Oil and mining rules and social contributions are in sibling skills.
